SEAF 火炮
SEAF Artillery
简单 至 超级绝地俯冲
super_earth
在任务规划期间，如果地图上存在火炮阵地，SEAF 火炮战略配备会被列为标准配备。炮弹将按装入的顺序每次使用该战略配备时发射。建议通过语音/文字聊天将炮弹的顺序告知队友。与轨道攻击不同，炮弹撞击的角度与超级驱逐舰的位置无关，而是完全垂直的。所有炮弹的最低拆毁值为 50，使它们能摧毁大多数结构。烟雾、静电场和凝固汽油弹炮弹需要直接命中。迷你核弹炮弹可以摧毁通常需要地狱火炸弹的目标，例如炮舰设施和机器人轨道加农炮。SEAF 火炮不会被战略配备干扰器或离子风暴禁用，并在任务时间耗尽时仍然可用。结合炮弹的拆毁值，可以安全地消除活跃的干扰器，而无需直接攻击它。SEAF 火炮炮弹可以利用特殊技巧投掷很远的距离：首先，站在炮弹前方，朝向你想投掷的方向。然后，与炮弹交互以拾起它，并在它到达你手中之前打开地图。最后，冲刺以关闭地图，接住投掷出的炮弹。与某些人的看法相反，激活火炮终端不会惊动附近的敌人，这只是巡逻路线的巧合。
During mission planning, the SEAF Artillery stratagem is listed as standard issue if an artillery site is present on the map. The shells will be fired in the order of when they were loaded each time the stratagem is used. Communicating the order of the shells to other teammates by voice/text chat is recommended. Unlike orbital strikes , the angle at which the shell will impact is independent of the Super Destroyer's position, being perfectly vertical instead. All artillery shells have a minimum Demolition of 50, allowing them to destroy most structures. Smoke, Static Field and Napalm shells will require direct hits. Mini-Nuke shells can destroy objectives that usually mandate a Hellbomb , such as the Gunship Facility and Automaton Orbital Cannon . The SEAF Artillery cannot be disabled by a Stratagem Jammer or Ion Storms , and remains available when mission time runs out. Combined with the shells' demolition force, an active jammer can be neutralized safely instead of having to assault it directly. SEAF Artillery shells can be thrown great distances by utilizing a special technique: First, standing in front of a shell in the direction you want the shell to be thrown. Then, interact with the shell to pick it up and open the map before it reaches your hands. Finally, sprint to close the map to grab the thrown shell. Contrary to some belief, activating the artillery terminal will not alert nearby enemies, it is simply coincidence due to patrol routes.
激活火炮终端
找到炮弹并将其装入火炮
• 最多七枚炮弹将散布在目标周围。其中五枚必须手动装载。
• 炮弹是双手物品，因此绝地潜兵在携带时无法冲刺或持有武器。
• 每枚炮弹在使用 SEAF 火炮战略配备时有不同效果。
使用终端建立与超级驱逐舰的通信
• 必须使用方向输入将信号强度提升至 100%。
等待火炮系统启动
• 此步骤会自动完成，因此在场的任何绝地潜兵都可以自由离开。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验、SEAF 火炮战略配备
• 使用该战略配备将促使火炮平台向信标发射一枚炮弹。
Activate Artillery Terminal
Find artillery shells and load them into artillery gun
• Up to seven shells will be scattered around the objective. Five of them must be loaded by hand.
• Shells are two-handed objects, so Helldivers cannot sprint or hold a weapon while carrying them.
• Each shell has a different effect when the SEAF Artillery stratagem is used.
Use terminal to establish communication with Super Destroyer
• Directional inputs must be used to raise the signal strength to 100%.
Wait for the artillery system to initiate
• This step will complete on its own, so any Helldivers present are free to leave.
Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience , SEAF Artillery stratagem
• Using the stratagem will prompt the artillery platform to fire a shell at the beacon.

SEAF 防空导弹阵地
SEAF SAM Site
简单 至 超级绝地俯冲
super_earth
SAM 阵地会瞄准以下敌人：运输舰、炮舰、刺魟、跃迁舰、利维坦。SAM 阵地一次只能瞄准一个敌人，多个阵地不会相互协调。这可能导致两座发射器向同一敌人开火，浪费弹药。SAM 阵地的高伤害使其能完全摧毁运输舰的机身，立即杀死所有乘员。跃迁舰的护盾可以使其抵消单枚导弹。绝地潜兵可能希望先手动击破护盾，以确保 SAM 阵地摧毁跃迁舰。导弹速度相对较低，因此可能错过较快的空中单位。值得注意的是，SAM 阵地可能无法在运输舰卸载乘员前将其摧毁。SAM 阵地发射时会产生显著的后爆。建议绝地潜兵在发射器激活时不要站在其后方，因为后爆威力足以杀死轻甲绝地潜兵。SAM 阵地可以被摧毁导致目标失败，原因未知。
SAM sites will target the following enemies: Dropship , Gunship , Stingray , Warp Ship , Leviathan The SAM site will only target one enemy at a time, and multiple sites will not coordinate with each other. This may result in two launchers firing at the same enemy, wasting their shots. The SAM site's high damage allows it to fully destroy a Dropship's fuselage, instantly killing all of its occupants. The Warp Ship's shield can allow it to nullify a single missile. Helldivers may wish to break the shield manually first to ensure the SAM site destroys the Warp Ship. The missile has a relatively low velocity, and as such may miss faster aerial units. Notably, SAM sites may fail to destroy Dropships before they unload their occupants. The SAM site generates significant backblast when firing. Helldivers are advised to not stand behind the launcher when it is activated, as the backblast is powerful enough to kill lightly armored Helldivers. The SAM Site can be destroyed causing the objective to fail, though the cause is unknown.
激活终端
使用终端升起地对空发射器
• 必须输入六位长代码。
• 此步骤后，绝地潜兵必须等待 SAM 发射器完全升起。
使用终端激活地对空发射器子系统
• 每个子系统必须单独激活。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验、SAM 发射器防空封锁
• 发射器携带二十四枚导弹，全部耗尽后停用。
Activate terminal
Use terminal to raise surface-to-air launcher
• A six-input long code must be inputted.
• After this step, Helldivers must wait for the SAM launcher to fully raise.
Use terminal to activate surface-to-air launcher sub-systems
• Each subsystem must be activated individually.
Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience , SAM launcher aerial denial
• The launcher carries twenty-four missiles, and will deactivate upon expending them all.

上传逃生舱数据
Upload Escape Pod Data
普通 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
开始上传过程会重置敌方增援冷却。敌人永远不会在坠毁的逃生舱附近生成。如果在任务简报中可见，这使其成为不错的初始降落点候选。
Beginning the upload process will reset the enemy reinforcement cooldown. Enemies will never spawn near the crashed escape pod. This makes it a good candidate for an initial drop location if it is visible during mission briefing.
使用上传数据战略配备开始上传
• 该战略配备在距离坠机地点 30 米内时可用。
• 其代码为：
上传期间保护（绝地潜兵）
• （绝地潜兵）是开始上传者的用户名。
• 上传需要 40 秒。如果上传者死亡或离开 30 米半径，上传进度会流失。
Use Upload Data stratagem to begin upload
• The stratagem becomes available when within 30 meters of the crash site.
• It has the following code:
Protect (Helldiver) during upload
• (Helldiver) is the username of whoever began the upload.
• The upload will take 40 seconds. If the uploader dies or leaves the 30 meter radius, the upload progress will drain.

传播民主
Spread Democracy
易如反掌 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
（如果没有绝地潜兵在 25 米范围内）靠近目标
• 绝地潜兵必须向目标位置靠近。
使用战略配备：超级地球旗帜
升旗中
• 绝地潜兵必须等待并防守旗帜，抵御持续的虫洞爆发/机器人空投，持续 1 分 40 秒直到目标完成。
• 旗帜完全升起后，必须杀光目标附近的所有敌人才能完成任务。
• 若所有绝地潜兵在任务完成前离开旗帜区域，旗帜进度将开始倒退。
(If no Helldiver is within the 25-meter range) Move closer to objective
• Helldivers must move closer to the objective location.
Use Stratagem: SUPER EARTH FLAG
Flag Raising
• Helldivers must wait and defend the flag from constant Bug Breaches/Bot Drops the entire one minute and forty seconds until the objective is complete.
• Enemies near the objective must be all killed once the flag has fully raised to complete the objective.
• Should all Helldivers leave the area of the flag before the objective is completed, the flag's progress will begin reversing.

使虚空民主化
Democratize the Void

侦测塔
Detector Tower
充满挑战 至 超级绝地俯冲
automatons
侦测塔有一个 150 米的探测范围，在其独特的红色视野锥内可以发现绝地潜兵。视野锥的位置意味着非常靠近侦测塔的绝地潜兵无法被发现。卧倒会使绝地潜兵对侦测塔完全隐形。如果绝地潜兵被发现，塔会发出可听见的警报，并开始召唤持续的机器人空投波次，直到它再也看不到任何绝地潜兵。以此方式生成的运输舰会在绝地潜兵最后已知位置部署单位。50 的拆毁要求意味着如果有替代选项，地狱火炸弹并非必需。常见例子包括飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、轨道精准攻击和 SEAF 火炮炮弹。巧妙的站位可以诱使加农炮炮塔用射击摧毁侦测塔。地狱火炸弹的大范围意味着可以远离侦测塔呼叫（在那里被发现的风险很小），仍能完成任务。侦测塔偶尔会在要塞内生成。它们与标准侦测塔功能相同，但地狱火炸弹将不可用。摧毁它们也并非将要塞标记为“已清除”的必要条件。
The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone. The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted. Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower. If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers. Dropships spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver. The Demolition requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available. Common examples include the Eagle 500kg Bomb , Orbital Precision Strike and SEAF Artillery shells. Clever positioning can trick Cannon Turrets into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots. The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective. Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of Fortresses . They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will not be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".
摧毁机器人侦测塔
• 靠近塔时，NUX-223 地狱火炸弹将可呼叫。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
• The NUX-223 Hellbomb will be available to call down when near the tower.
Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience

关闭终结族控制系统
Deactivate Terminid Control System
易如反掌 至 绝境
any
被摧毁后，变异卵会击退并伤害 10 米内的绝地潜兵。区域内会生成一种较小版本的孢子喷射者结构，产生比其较大同类稍稀薄的雾气。可以摧毁这些小型喷射者以消除雾气。地图上可能生成次要兴趣点；值得注意的是自杀任务及以上难度会出现超级样本岩石。
When destroyed, the mutated eggs will knock back and damage Helldivers within 10 meters. A smaller version of the Spore Spewer structure spawns within the area, creating fog of slightly less dense than its larger counterpart. These small spewers can be destroyed to remove the fog Minor Place of Interest can potentially spawn on the map; this notably includes the Super Sample Rock on Suicide Mission and above.
关闭损坏的电池仓 [0/3]
• 绝地潜兵必须前往地图上标记的 3 个位置，并在每个位置按下按钮。
• 按下按钮会导致虫洞爆发持续发生，直到撤离可用。
Deactivate corrupted battery silos [0/3]
• Helldivers have to go to the 3 spots marked on the map and interact with a button on each location.
• Pressing the button will cause Bug Breaches to continuously occur until extraction is available.

净化孵化巢
Purge Hatcheries
简单 至 超级绝地俯冲
terminids
这些卵脆弱、数量众多且成簇出现。建议绝地潜兵携带造成爆炸伤害的武器和战略配备，例如 CB-9 爆燃弩、R-36 爆裂铳、GL-21 榴弹发射器、AC-8 机炮或飞鹰空袭。单枚 B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或飞鹰 500kg 炸弹即可摧毁巢内所有卵。由于卵在摧毁前无法承受太多伤害，FLAM-40 火焰喷射器是个高效选择。虽然绝地潜兵能用徒手近战伤害摧毁卵，但爆裂的卵会产生冲击波，将绝地潜兵推向致命的撞击伤害。幸运的是，即使是 CQC-5 战斗斧和 CQC-30 眩晕警棍等短程近战武器也有足够的攻击距离，可以在不被弹飞的风险下处理卵。
The Eggs are fragile, numerous, and found in clusters. Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , AC-8 Autocannon or the Eagle Airstrike . A single B-100 Portable Hellbomb or Eagle 500kg Bomb can destroy all the eggs in the nest. Since the Eggs can't take much damage before being destroyed, the FLAM-40 Flamethrower is an efficient choice. While Helldivers are able to destroy eggs with bare-handed melee damage, the bursting eggs create a shockwave sending a Helldiver into fatal impact-damage. Fortunately even short-range melee-weapons such as CQC-5 Combat Hatchet and CQC-30 Stun Baton have long enough reach to dispose eggs without the risk of being expulsed.
摧毁卵：“该区域存放着大量卵。使用任何必要手段摧毁它们。——任务简报”
[ edit | edit source ] Destroy Eggs [ edit | edit source ] “ Large quantities of eggs are located in this area. Use any means necessary to destroy them. — Mission Briefing

净化感染区域
Cleanse Infested District
充满挑战 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
塔顶往往比塔基更宽，形成明显的悬垂。绝地潜兵在呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹时应小心，确保绝地喷射仓不会在呼叫时卡在塔上。虽然比普通尖啸虫巢穴拥有多得多的生命值，但和所有终结族建筑一样，它们几乎没有任何护甲，可以从远距离用任何持续伤害来源摧毁。它们需要 50 的拆毁值才能直接摧毁。爱国者和解放者外骨骼装甲非常适合此任务，尽管这样做会耗尽它们的弹药储备。TD-220 堡垒 MK-XVI 可以用 4 发炮弹摧毁单座塔，或用主炮 3 发加上同轴重机枪约 66 发摧毁。M-1000 重装机枪对终结族建筑拥有出色的持续射击能力，或许是快速击倒一座塔的最佳支援武器（弹药另说）。使用分配的 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹摧毁塔时，要当心附近的平民和 SEAF 士兵，因为他们缺乏态势感知，不知道躲避其巨大爆炸。
The tops of the towers are often wider than their base, creating a significant overhang. Helldivers should take care when calling in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to ensure the hellpod does not get stuck on the tower when called in. While possessing significantly more health than a regular Shrieker Nest , like all Terminid structures they have almost no armour and can be destroyed via any source of sustained damage from range. They require a demo force of 50 to destroy outright. The Patriot and Emancipator Exo-suits are ideal for this, although doing so will deplete their ammo reserves. The TD-220 Bastion MK XVI can destroy a single tower with either 4 shots, or 3 shots with the main gun and ~66 shots from the coaxial HMG. The M-1000 Maxigun has excellent sustained-fire capability against the Terminid structures, and is perhaps the best support weapon to bring down a tower quickly, ammo notwithstanding. When using the allocated NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the tower, be wary of any nearby Civilians and SEAF Troopers , as their lack of situational awareness means they do not have the sense to avoid its massive blast.
这座建筑已被终结族占领，现在成了尖啸虫的繁殖地。
• 绝地潜兵必须前往标记的感染塔，并在其附近引爆一枚地狱火炸弹。
This building has been overrun by Terminids and is now a Shrieker breeding ground.
• Helldivers must make their way to the marked Infested Tower and detonate a Hellbomb in its vicinity.

击落主宰舰
Take Down Overship
易如反掌 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
当光能者统御舰被射击时，它会通过在绝地潜兵身上召唤跃迁舰进行报复。目前它对地面资产没有其他影响。将行星防御加农炮的炮管瞄准统御舰最近的一个舷窗，可以在护盾被禁用后 1 发命中目标，需要 2 发。这大大缩短了摧毁它所需的时间。如果绝地潜兵在发射行星防御加农炮之间花太长时间，统御舰的护盾可以再生。可能需要发射额外炮弹以再次停用护盾。尽管用行星防御加农炮射击护盾是最直接的方式，但它们也可以用常规武器造成伤害。当护盾完好时，如果 20 秒内护盾未受到伤害，它将开始以每秒 500 生命值的速度再生。一旦护盾落下，如果统御舰届时尚未被摧毁，它会在 60 秒后重新出现并开始再生。
When the Illuminate Overship is shot, it will retaliate by summoning Warp Ships on the Helldivers . It currently has no other effect on ground assets. Aiming the barrel of the Planetary Defense Cannon at the closest Port hole of the Overship will 1-shot the target once the shields have been disabled, requiring 2 shots. This drastically reduces the time needed to destroy it. The Overship's Shield can regenerate if Helldivers take too long firing the Planetary Defense Cannon in-between shots. Additional shells may need to be fired in order to deactivate the shield again. Despite firing at the shields with the Planetary Defense Cannon to be the most straightforward, they can be damaged with conventional weaponry. While the shield is still intact, if 20 seconds pass without the shield taking damage, it will begin to regenerate at a rate of 500 health per second. Once the shield has fallen, it will reappear after 60 seconds and start to regenerate, assuming the Overship hasn't been destroyed by then.
找到包含访问代码的硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须前往优先紧急地堡，然后通过开门找出正确的门，并从内部的架子上取回访问代码。它以偏灰色的矩形外观并带有紫色圆圈为特征，与发射洲际弹道导弹任务中的访问代码外观相同。它会持续发出静电和摩斯电码的声音，距离包含代码的硬盘越近声音越大。
Find the hard disk containing the Access Codes.
• Helldivers must go to the Priority Emergency Bunkers then figure out which door is the correct one by opening them and then retrieving the Access Codes from the shelves inside. It is distinguished by a gray-ish rectangular appearance with a purple circle, identical to the appearance of Access Codes in Launch ICBM missions. It emits a constant sound of static and morse code, getting louder the closer the Helldiver is to the Disk containing the Codes.

击退入侵舰队
Repel Invasion Fleet
普通 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
摧毁已着陆的跃迁舰，直到跃迁舰储备归零且每一艘已着陆的跃迁舰都被摧毁。
防止超级地球对该区域的控制降至 0。当大量光能者舰船部署时，控制会开始下降。
Destroy Warp Ships that have landed until Warp Ship reserves hit zero and every landed Warp Ship is destroyed.
Prevent Super Earth's control of the area from hitting 0. Control starts to diminish when a high number of Illuminate ships are deployed.

削弱机器人防御
Compromise Automaton Defenses
充满挑战 至 超级绝地俯冲
automatons
前哨通常受到两侧多个加农炮炮塔的重兵把守。大型工厂上的前哨还包含防空阵地，会禁用 150 米内绝地潜兵的任何飞鹰战略配备。目标完成后，地图上所有加农炮炮塔、地堡炮塔、迫击炮阵地和防空阵地都会开始故障，明显冒出火花并向随机方向开火，无法瞄准绝地潜兵或阻止飞鹰部署。迫击炮阵地等可选目标在被削弱时不会完成。绝地潜兵仍必须摧毁它们才能获得完成奖励。指挥地堡炮塔在完成后也会受影响。
The outpost is typically heavily guarded by several Cannon Turrets on each side. Outposts on Megafactories also contain Anti-Air Emplacements that will disable the use of any Eagle Stratagems for Helldivers within 150m. When the objective is completed, all Cannon Turrets, Bunker Turrets , Mortar Emplacements , and Anti-Air Emplacements on the map will start to malfunction, visibly sparking and firing in random directions, unable to target Helldivers or deny Eagle deployments. Optional Objectives such as Mortar Emplacements will not be completed when compromised. Helldivers must still destroy them to gain completion rewards. Command Bunker turrets are also affected upon completion.
定位并解锁系统访问端口

The structure has Light Armor and can be destroyed by most Weapon or Stratagem . However, its 100% durable narrows the amount of effective primary weaponry to destroy it quickly and with less ammo usage. Shriekers will only spawn if there are Helldivers within 130 meters of the nest detected by the enemy. Helldivers may know the distance of a point by pinging it. 在任务的普通变体中，车队由 5 座移动工厂组成：4 座带加农炮炮塔，1 座带战略配备扰乱器（功能上与认知干扰器相同，伪装成缩小版的战略配备干扰器）。干扰器无护甲，5,000 生命值，0% 耐久度，因此可以被任何武器摧毁，不过最好用反坦克等高伤害武器。车队中的移动工厂与普通不同，受到攻击时可以呼叫增援，从其中一座工厂的后部向空中发射几发机器人信号弹。呼叫的增援会空投在触发增援的绝地潜兵身上。建议指定一名绝地潜兵引诱增援空投，以便其余队友不受干扰地处理移动工厂。在生化人变体中，移动工厂会被 5 台噪轰引擎取代，全部是没有特殊能力的普通噪轰引擎。噪轰引擎版本更容易对付，因为它似乎没有能力在约 150 米外交战，并且被击中时无法呼叫任何增援，这意味着用 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井或反坦克炮台等远程反坦克火力从远处对付它们要容易得多。车队被交战时不会停止，会继续沿路径驶离地图。建议将此次要目标视为高优先级，成为小队在任务中应最早完成的目标之一。车队完成路径约需 700 秒，即 11 分 40 秒（如果车队不受打扰）。只要第一座移动工厂越过任务区域边界，目标就会失败。车队的噪轰引擎变体由于移动速度稍快，约 600 秒或 10 分钟完成路径。车队不太愿意偏离预定路径太多，因此如果你靠近移动工厂，从后方接近是相对更安全的选择。对抗移动工厂的相同战术适用于此次要目标，同时要考虑同时对抗五座以及战略配备扰乱器。因此，建议使用 E/AT-12 反坦克炮台（ATE）、轨道激光炮和轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网等反坦克战略配备，或 B/MD C4 背包、EAT-411 荡平者、GR-8 无后坐力炮和 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井等支援武器。当远距离定位并有良好的高视线时，ATE 是摧毁车队最有效和安全的方式之一，有足够多的炮弹瞄准其正面摧毁全部 5 座。将 ATE 放置在车队前方与其路径对角约 100-150 米处，更容易看到其正面并对暴露的头部部位 2 发命中。建议先摧毁顶部加农炮，消除车队主要的远程还击手段。放置得当的 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井可以立即摧毁至少 2 座移动工厂，大大加快任务完成。MD-17 反坦克地雷也是可行选择，2-3 枚地雷的爆炸力足以杀死或重伤一座移动工厂。车队沿非常可预测的路径行进，只需沿线放置地雷即可增强你的火力。
In the normal variant of the mission, the convoy consists of 5 Factory Striders: 4 with Cannon Turrets and 1 with a Stratagem Scrambler (functionally identical to Cognitive Disruptor masqueraded as a downsized Stratagem Jammer ). The Jammer is Unarmored , 5,000 health, and 0% durable, so it can be destroyed by any weapon, although preferably with high damage weapons such as anti-tank. The Striders in a convoy, unlike normal Striders, can call in reinforcements when attacked, launching several bot flares into the air from one of the striders' rear. The reinforcement called in will be dropped ON the diver who triggered the reinforcement. It is advisable to assign one diver to lure the reinforcement drop so the rest of the team can deal with the striders without interruption. In the Cyborg variant of the mission, the Factory Striders will be replaced by 5 Vox Engines, all of which are normal Vox Engines without special capabilities. The Vox Engine version can be more easily dealt with, since it does not seem to have a capability to engage beyond ~150m and cannot call in any reinforcement upon being struck, meaning it is significantly easier to deal with them from a distance with long ranged anti-tank firepower such as the MS-11 Solo Silo or E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement . The convoy will not stop when engaged and will continue on its path to leave the map. It is advised to treat this secondary objective with high priority, being one of the very first ones that your squad should complete during the mission. The convoy completes its path in ~700 seconds, or 11 minutes and 40 seconds if the convoy is left untouched. The objective fails as soon as the first Factory Strider crosses the mission area border. The Vox Engine variant of the convoy, due to its slightly faster moving speed, completes its path in ~600 seconds, or around 10 minutes. The convoy is hesitant to turn too much from their intended path, so approaching from behind is a relatively safer option if you're close to the Factory Striders. The same tactics for fighting Factory Striders apply to this secondary objective, accounting for fighting five of them at once, along with the stratagem scrambler. Therefore, Anti-Tank stratagems such as the E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement (ATE), Orbital Laser and Orbital 380mm HE Barrage or Support Weapons such as the B/MD C4 Pack , EAT-411 Leveller , GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and MS-11 Solo Silo are recommended. When positioned far away with a good, elevated line of sight, the ATE is one of the most efficient and safe ways to take down a convoy, having more than enough shells to destroy all 5 if aiming for their faces. Place the ATE ahead of the convoy at an approximate 100-150m distance diagonal to their path to make it easier to see their face and 2 shot the exposed part of the head. It is recommended to destroy the top cannons first, removing the convoy's primary method of long-range return fire. A well-placed MS-11 Solo Silo can instantly destroy at least 2 of the Factory Striders , greatly expediting completion of the objective. The MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines are also a viable choice, having enough explosive power to kill or severely wound a Factory Strider in 2-3 mines. The convoy follows a very predictable path, so simply place the mines along it to augment your firepower.

霸王虫：霸王虫拥有游戏中最高的主体生命值池，达 150,000。但所有身体部位耐久度均为 0%，因此所有来源的伤害都会造成全额标准伤害。由于其极其庞大的生命值池和广泛横扫的致命攻击，建议整个小队要么完全避开霸王虫，要么协调将其击倒。霸王虫的身体完全覆盖着坦克 I 护甲，头部是坦克 II 护甲，以及它那轻甲的敞开嘴巴。其身体护甲可以用持续的反坦克火力击破，露出下面轻甲的血肉。当一块护甲板接近被摧毁时，会明显出现裂纹和破损。内部血肉完全免疫爆炸伤害，因此应避免使用 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井等爆炸武器。霸王虫板甲的大部分韧性来自其庞大、不衰减的流血池。它充当额外生命值，每个部位总计 50,000 有效生命值。希望击倒霸王虫的绝地潜兵应考虑以战略配备和支援武器的形式携带尽可能多的反坦克 I 火力。飞鹰机枪扫射和轨道加特林攻击对霸王虫都非常有效，因为霸王虫体型巨大，可以伤害多块脊椎护甲板。GR-8 无后坐力炮、FAF-14 飞矛和 EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭可以在轨道和飞鹰冷却之间专注于击破护甲板。EXO-45 爱国者外骨骼是对抗霸王虫最有效的工具之一。其导弹臂可以用火箭帮助剥离护甲板，对护甲板造成总计高达 17,500 点伤害，使其加特林臂能快速对剥离的部分造成巨大伤害。满弹匣时，加特林机枪可以这种方式造成高达 121,500 点伤害。然而，由于机动性有限和体型庞大，外骨骼容易受到霸王虫大型攻击的伤害。堡垒坦克对霸王虫同样有效，因为它生命值高，能承受多次胆汁攻击，其大型加农炮和重机枪弹药储备可以摧毁一块护甲板并造成足够伤害轻松击杀霸王虫。但驾驶员必须机动坦克远离钻地的霸王虫，以防止霸王虫掀翻坦克。B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹如果绝地潜兵能正确放置，可以造成极端伤害。使用它的最佳时机通常是霸王虫试图喷吐胆汁时，因为这种攻击不会在极近距离命中，并能让它保持位置足够长的时间让地狱火炸弹的倒计时完成。护甲被击破后，高 DPS 武器可以通过射击暴露的轻甲血肉来撕裂其主体生命值池。AR-61 肉锤、M-105 盟友、MGX-42 子弹风暴和 M-1000 重装机枪等武器表现良好。LIFT-850 喷射背包或 LIFT-182 传送背包可以用来躲避霸王虫的攻击。轻甲和实验灌注增益器进一步提高步行移动速度，结合这些选项可以提高生存几率。霸王虫的移动会引起地面震动，减缓附近所有单位。在考虑其他终结族存在时，应避免过于接近。霸王虫对所有使其眩晕或困惑的效果免疫，但仍容易受到直接毒气伤害和火焰点燃。与霸王虫交战时或撤退时，绝地潜兵应彼此保持距离。霸王虫攻击的规模使其彼此靠近很危险，因为一次打击可能杀死所有人。霸王虫胆汁造成的大部分伤害是爆炸性的，因此携带强化被动技能的护甲可以帮助绝地潜兵免受这些攻击或使其伤害可忽略不计。
Hive Lord [ edit | edit source ] The Hive Lord has the largest Main health pool in the game by a significant margin, at 150,000 . But all body parts are 0% durable, so it takes full standard damage from all sources. Due to its extremely large health pool and wide sweeping lethal attacks, it is advised that the entire squad either avoids the Hive Lord entirely or coordinates to take it down. The Hive Lord's body is completely encased in Tank I armor, with the exception being Tank II armor on the head and it's Light armored open mouth. Its body armor can be broken with sustained anti-tank fire, revealing the Light -armored flesh beneath. When a plate of armor is close to being destroyed, it will visibly show cracks and breaks. The inner flesh is completely immune to explosion damage, so explosive weapons like the MS-11 Solo Silo should be avoided. Most of the toughness of the Hive Lord's plate armor comes from its massive, non-decaying bleedout pool. It behaves as extra health, for a total of 50,000 effective health per section. Helldivers who wish to take down a Hive Lord should consider bringing as much Anti-Tank I firepower as possible in the form of Stratagems and Support Weapons . Eagle Strafing Run and Orbital Gatling Barrage are both highly effective against the Hive Lord, as they can damage multiple spinal armor plates due to the Hive Lord's massive size. The GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , FAF-14 Spear , and EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank allow for focusing on breaking armor plates between orbital and Eagle cooldowns. The EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit is one of the most effective tools against a Hive Lord. Its missile arm can help strip an armor plate with rockets, dealing up to a total of 17,500 damage to an armor plate, allowing its Gatling arm to quickly inflict massive damage upon the stripped section. With a full magazine, the chaingun can deal up to 121,500 damage in this manner. However, due to their limited mobility and large frames, Exosuits are vulnerable to the Hive Lord's large attacks. The Bastion is likewise effective against a Hive Lord due to its high HP pool, allowing it to withstand multiple bile attacks, and its large cannon and HMG ammo reserves can destroy a plate and deal enough damage to take out the Hive Lord with ease. However, the driver must maneuver the tank away from burrowing Hive Lords to prevent the Hive Lord from flipping the tank. The B-100 Portable Hellbomb can inflict an extreme amount of damage if Helldivers can position it correctly. The best time to use it is typically when the Hive Lord attempts to spew bile, as this attack does not hit at point-blank range and keeps it in place long enough for the Hellbomb's countdown to finish. Once the armor is broken, high DPS weapons can be used to shred its main health pool by firing into the exposed Light armored flesh. Weapons such as the AR-61 Tenderizer , M-105 Stalwart , MGX-42 Bullet Storm , and M-1000 Maxigun perform well at this. The LIFT-850 Jump Pack or LIFT-182 Warp Pack can be used to avoid the Hive Lord's attacks. Light armor and the Experimental Infusion booster further increase movement speed on foot, and combining these options together can improve odds of survival. The Hive Lord's movements will cause tremors in the ground that slow all nearby units. Close proximity should be avoided when considering the presence of other Terminids The Hive Lord is immune to all effects that would stun or confuse it, whilst still being prone to direct gas damage and ignition by fire. When engaging or withdrawing from the Hive Lord, Helldivers should maintain distance from one another. The size of the Hive Lord's attacks makes it dangerous for them to remain close to each other, as one strike could potentially kill all of them. Most of the damage dealt by the bile of a Hive Lord is explosive, so bringing armor with the Fortified passive can help save Helldivers from these attacks or even make their damage negligible.

一般信息：区域分为两个部分。外墙有 2 扇门，每个敌人来袭方向各一扇，内墙有 1 扇门。这些门可以关闭以减缓敌人，或打开以取回外部的装备并让绝地潜兵返回。区域内已部署多座 E/MG-101 重机枪部署支架，但弹药不足总量的一半——外墙后 2 座，内墙后 2 座。附近可以找到补给。某些支援武器出现在特定位置。任务区域整体较小，因此轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网等大规模战略配备往往更容易误杀队友。配置装备时，建议查看队友的装备并选择能与之配合的战略配备。例如，若一名绝地潜兵选择了 A/ARC-3 特斯拉塔，则不建议携带飞鹰 500kg 炸弹等破坏性过强的战略配备。由于任务时间相对较短，EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭、MD-6 反步兵雷区或 MLS-4X 突击兵等冷却时间短的战略配备在本任务中更有价值。同理，轨道激光炮战略配备在本任务中可以更自由地使用。关闭最靠近发电机的门可以防止潜行敌人偷偷穿过防线。当发电机正被攻击时，会响起警报。机器人信息：绝地潜兵应携带哨戒炮、部署支架和反坦克支援武器，以应对坦克和移动工厂的加农炮炮塔，并配合与难度相符的战略配备。例如困难难度会有多台巨型者。E/AT-12 反坦克炮台可以轻松击落大部分运输舰，从而产生更小的敌波，可用迫击哨戒炮或机炮哨戒炮清理。或者，两名绝地潜兵用 GR-8 无后坐力炮进行协助装填，并配合稳定的补给，也能起到类似效果。自杀任务及以上难度，应优先处理正在空投的移动工厂，因为在它们落地前摧毁运输舰可直接击杀它们。被击落的运输舰很容易压垮防御大门。除非启用炮舰巡逻行动修正，否则炮舰永远不会生成。终结族信息：如果强袭虫撞击任何大门，大门会立即坍塌。利用火焰武器，如飞鹰凝固汽油弹空袭或 MD-I4 燃烧地雷，可以在虫洞爆发前将其压制。除非星球上激活掠食变种，否则追踪虫永远不会在本任务中生成。同样，除非启用游荡尖啸虫行动修正，否则尖啸虫不会生成。站得太靠近城垛边缘可能被猎手飞扑造成伤害，即使大门关闭也是如此。光能者信息：利维坦永远不会直接瞄准发电机，但仍可能通过附带伤害摧毁它们。猎杀器构成除刺魟以外最大的威胁，因为它们极其强大的远程激光束可以瞬间摧毁发电机并击杀绝地潜兵。因此，它们一出现就必须被消灭。E/MG-101 重机枪部署支架在光能者任务中表现出色，因为它能撕开每个敌人的护甲（利维坦除外），尤其适合对付刺魟。悬浮监察者经常飞越城垛，完全无视大门，因此被视为高优先级目标。RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器在光能者任务中极为有利，其大范围集束爆炸可以单发火箭清掉成群的无票者、监察者和肉瘤体。建议优先携带 RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器而非飞鹰集束炸弹，因为它不受冷却限制，只受补给限制。
General Information [ edit | edit source ] The area is divided into 2 sections. The outer wall has 2 doors, 1 for each direction the enemies can come from, and 1 inner wall with 1 door. These doors may be closed to slow down enemies or opened to retrieve Equipment from outside and let Helldivers back in. There are multiple E/MG-101 HMG Emplacements already stationed, though they will have less than half of their total ammo. 2 behind the outside wall and 2 behind the inside wall. Supplies can be found around the area. Certain Support Weapons can be found in specific spots. The overall mission area is small, making large-scale strategems such as the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage kill teammates more often than not. When building a loadout, it is recommended to look at teammates' loadouts and select stratagems that will work well with theirs. For example, if the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower has been selected by one Helldiver, it is not recommended to bring an overtly destructive strategem such as the Eagle 500kg Bomb . Stratagems with short cooldowns such as the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank , MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield , or MLS-4X Commando find more value in this mission, due to the relatively short mission time. On a similar note, the Orbital Laser Strategem can be used far more liberally in this mission for the same reason. Closing the gate nearest the Generators can prevent any stealthy enemies from sneaking by the defensive line. When the Generators are actively being damaged, an alarm will sound. Automaton Information [ edit | edit source ] Helldivers should bring Sentries , Emplacements , and anti-tank support weapons to deal with Tanks and Factory Strider cannon turrets in addition to Difficulty appropriate Stratagems . Hard for example will have multiple Hulks . An E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement can easily down most of the Dropships , resulting in smaller enemy waves that can be mopped up by a Mortar or Autocannon sentry. Alternatively, two Helldivers performing an Assisted Reload with a GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and a steady supply of Resupplies can work similarly. On Suicide Mission and above, Factory Striders which are being dropped into the battlefield should be prioritized, as destroying the Dropship before they can drop the Factory Strider on the ground will instantly kill it. Downed Dropships can crush the Defense Gates very easily. Gunships will never spawn, unless the Gunship Patrols Operation Modifier is active. Terminid Information [ edit | edit source ] If a Charger rams into any gate, it will instantly collapse. Utilizing fire weaponry, such as the Eagle Napalm Airstrike or MD-I4 Incendiary Mines can shut down bug breaches before they even become a problem. Stalkers will never spawn in this mission, unless the Predator Strain is active on the planet. Likewise, Shriekers will never spawn, unless the Roving Shriekers Operation Modifier is active. Standing too close to the edge of the battlements can cause Hunters to fly up and deal damage, even if the gates are closed. Illuminate Information [ edit | edit source ] Leviathans will never target the generators directly, but can still destroy them through collateral damage. Harvesters pose the highest threat of any enemy barring the Stingray due to their extremely powerful long-range laser beams that can instantly destroy generators and kill Helldivers. Therefore, their demise must be met upon arrival. The E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement excels on Illuminate missions, due to its ability to tear through every enemy's armor (excluding the Leviathan). It is especially useful for taking down Stingrays. Elevated Overseers will oftentimes fly over the battlements, ignoring the gates completely. As such, they are considered high-priority targets. 敌方生物处理器
Enemy Bio-Processors
普通 至 超级绝地俯冲
automatons
由于生物处理器完全没有护甲，它们容易受到所有绝地潜兵武器（包括基础轻武器火力）的伤害。如果绝地潜兵能在生物处理器附近投掷高伤害或 40 拆毁值的战略配备（例如飞鹰空袭），则可以轻松避免与机器人前哨的正面冲突。与其他需要绝地潜兵摧毁结构的可选目标类似，当绝地潜兵接近生物处理器时会提供地狱火炸弹战略配备。虽然这种方法允许绝地潜兵不使用自己的弹药或战略配备就摧毁生物处理器，但呼叫和武装地狱火炸弹的时间比使用其他破坏手段要长得多。一些基地的布局可能导致生物处理器彼此距离足够远，单枚地狱火炸弹无法全部摧毁，也无法保证轨道 120mm 高爆弹火力网或轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网能全部命中。然而轨道激光炮会立即摧毁它们并追踪整个位置来清理目标，如果投掷得足够近，是个有效解决方案。2 个 G-123 铝热弹可以摧毁一个生物处理器，但前提是投掷得足够近，让整个燃烧时长作用于结构，因为爆炸只造成 2000 伤害，但计入燃烧伤害最高可达 2975。一些拆毁值 40 或更高的摧毁生物处理器的选项如下：绝地喷射仓撞击的拆毁值为 40，可以摧毁生物处理器，只需在生物处理器的两半之间的空隙投掷战略配备球（用于任何乘绝地喷射仓降落的东西，例如提供的地狱火炸弹战略配备）即可轻松实现。生物处理器也可以用 B/MD C4 背包的单个炸药、EAT-411 荡平者或 GP-20 最后通牒一发，或单个 TED-63 炸药/G-48 千兆级榴弹摧毁。
As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw either high-damaging or demo force 40 Stratagems near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle Airstrike . Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. The layout of some bases can cause Bio-Processors to be sufficiently far away from each other that a single Hellbomb cannot destroy them all, and cannot guarantee that the Orbital 120mm HE Barrage or Orbital 380mm HE Barrage will get them all. However the Orbital Laser will destroy them instantly and will track across the location to clear the objective, making it an effective solution if thrown close enough. 2 G-123 Thermite grenades will destroy a Bio-Processor, but only if they are thrown from close enough for the entire burn duration to apply to the structure, as the explosion only deals 2000 damage but can deal up to 2975 with the burn damage included. Some demolition force 40 or higher options to destroy the bio-processors are as follows: Hellpod impacts are demolition force 40, which can destroy Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processor, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single charge from the B/MD C4 Pack , one shot from the EAT-411 Leveller or GP-20 Ultimatum , or a single TED-63 Dynamite / G-48 Giga Grenade .

由于歼灭任务的性质，强烈推荐重武器和较重护甲，尽管这最终取决于绝地潜兵对抗光能者部队的偏好。由于光能者敌人更依赖护盾而非护甲，携带反坦克武器并非必需，不过这最终取决于绝地潜兵在小队中的角色，尤其是专精消灭重型敌人的角色，例如肉瘤体和猎杀器。还应考虑该星球上存在的子阵营类型，因为某些敌人需要不同的应对策略。虽然几乎可以用甚轻武器消灭所有光能者敌人，但建议装备穿透等级为轻或更高的主武器和/或副武器，以减少在与支援武器分离时被敌人淹没的压力。与其他阵营不同，光能者更依赖机动性而非纯粹的火力来取胜。
Due to the nature of Eradication missions, heavy weapons and heavier armor are highly recommended, though this ultimately depends on a Helldiver's preference against Illuminate forces. Since Illuminate enemies rely more on shields than armor, bring Anti-Tank weaponry is not required, though this ultimately depends on a Helldiver's role in their squad, especially ones that specialize in taking down heavier enemies, such as Fleshmobs and Harvesters . Additional considerations should also be taken as to the types of subfactions present on that planet, as certain enemies will require different approaches to their doctrines. While it is possible to eliminate almost all Illuminate enemies with Very Light weaponry, it is recommended to equip a Primary and/or Secondary Weapon with an Light penetration or higher in order to reduce the stress of being overwhelmed by enemies when separated from your Support Weapon. Unlike other factions, the Illuminate depend more on mobility to overcome rather than pure firepower.

歼灭机器人部队
Eradicate Automaton Forces
简单 至 超级绝地俯冲
any
歼灭任务与塔防类似，绝地潜兵必须“守住”任务区域并消灭来袭敌人。由于本任务的性质，绝地潜兵应装备擅长消灭成群敌人的护甲、战略配备和武器。强烈推荐使用 RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器，因为它具有巨大的区域清理能力、可装填的特性，并且可以在其他区域清理战略配备不可用时使用。最佳用法是驻守在高处山脊上，向成群的机器人射击，并务必使用正确的模式以避免过早引爆（通常会导致操作者或队友死亡）。装备重甲会提高穿着者的生存能力，因为狭小的任务区域和大量的敌人几乎没有机动和躲避敌人攻击的空间。由于机器人会从运输舰部署，强烈建议装备能够消灭它们的支援武器（要么摧毁引擎，要么摧毁车辆本身）。然而，摧毁运输舰不计入击杀数；这只是为了减轻压力并减少来袭敌人。不过，如果运输舰已部署部队，其坠落和爆炸可能导致其载荷被摧毁。部署哨戒炮在本任务中也很有益，因为它可以协助消灭敌人并支援绝地潜兵。部署位置需特别小心，以最大化覆盖范围并防止友军误伤（无论是误伤队友、哨戒炮本身，还是火力线上的附近哨戒炮）。
Eradication Missions are set up similarly to Tower Defenses , where Helldivers must "hold" the mission area and eliminate the incoming enemies. Due to the nature of this mission, Helldivers should equip armor, stratagems , and weapons that are effective at eliminating hordes of enemies. Using the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher is highly recommended due to its massive area clearing capabilities, reloadable nature and can be used when other area clearing stratagems are not available. The best way to use it is to post up on an elevated ridge and shoot down at the hordes of bots and be sure to use the proper modes to avoid a premature detonation which will likely occur in operator and/or teammate death. Equipping Heavy Armor will increase the wearer's survivability, as the small mission area and high volume of enemies results in little room to maneuver and dodge enemy attacks. Since Automatons will be deployed from Dropships , equipping Support Weapons that can eliminate them (either destroying the engines, or the vehicle itself) is highly recommended. However, destroying Dropships will not count towards the kill count; it is only to relieve pressure and reduce the enemies inbound. If the Dropship has deployed its troops, though, its fall and explosion may cause its payload to be destroyed. Deploying Sentries are also beneficial during this mission since it can aid in eliminating enemies, as well as supporting Helldivers in their task. Special care should be taken in their placement to maximize their coverage, and prevent friendly fire. (either to fellow Helldivers, the sentry themselves, or nearby sentries in the line of fire)

The Mortar Emplacement will only fire at enemy targets if they have been spotted by other automatons Additionally a Mortar Emplacement will only fire on those within 150m but can't see targets closer than 20m. When a Mortar Emplacement is firing at you, Mission Control will warn you with a voiceline: "Warning: you are in range of enemy artillery!" The mortar shells comes with bright red trails when traveling in the air. Players can look to the sky to determine the direction and location of the Mortar Emplacement. The majority of the mortar emplacement is covered in Heavy armor, while having Medium weakspots on the back, therefore any Heavy armor-penetrating weapon such as the AC-8 Autocannon and LAS-98 Laser Cannon can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb . Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements. The RS-422 Railgun requires an 80% charge shot to destroy. The PLAS-45 Epoch requires a fully-charged shot. Weapons with Medium penetration can still kill a Mortar Emplacement from range. However, because this can only damage them from the back, the Helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position. This is most easily performed when the Mortar Emplacement is shooting at a teammate, as every emplacement will be facing in the same direction without turning erratically. Weapons that only have Heavy penetration should also try to target the weakspots as they inflict their full damage on them leading to a far quicker kill with less ammo expended. This is especially true for weapons that have shrapnel, as shrapnel has Medium penetration, often leading to a 1-shot. Damaging Grenades that have Heavy or above can destroy Mortar Emplacement. Thermite can 1-shot Mortar Emplacement if it sticks to it Both G-12 High Explosive and TED-63 Dynamite can also 1-shot Mortar Emplacement but requires them to detonate very close to the structure, typically by cooking the grenade and throwing it so it explodes in the air. Mortar Emplacements can also be destroyed by any of the offensive Stratagems , Emplacement Stratagems , as well as the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or to save ammo.

Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging Stratagem near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle 500kg Bomb . Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. A Hellpod has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. A single well-placed Flak mode rocket from the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher can destroy 2 bio-processors as well as a couple enemies. Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or a TED-63 Dynamite throwable.

When a Helldiver is within 150m of an Anti-Air Emplacement, all Eagles become unusable. Their call-in sequences will be replaced by a message reading "Obstructed by Anti-Air". Anti-Air Emplacements will shoot upwards periodically letting players looking into the distance identify the location of the Anti-Air Emplacement. The majority of the Anti-Air Emplacement is covered in Heavy armor, while having a Medium weakspot on the back, therefore any Heavy armor-penetrating weapon such as the AC-8 Autocannon and LAS-98 Laser Cannon can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb . Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements. The RS-422 Railgun requires an 80% charge shot to destroy. The PLAS-45 Epoch is a 1 shot with an uncharged shot. Weapons with Medium penetration can still kill a Anti-Air Emplacement from range however because they can only damage them from the back a helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position or wait for them to turn in a favorable direction. Oddly enough, AA Emplacements will rotate and "target" all Guard Dogs so stowing your Guard Dog by pressing the "Use Backpack Function" button ( PC default press 5 , PlayStation default press D-Pad Down ) is recommended to prevent aggro and make flanking the Emplacement easier. Weapons that only have Heavy penetration should also try to target the weakspots as they inflict their full damage on them leading to a far faster kill with less ammo expended. This is especially true for weapons that have shrapnel, as shrapnel has Medium penetration, often leading to a 1-shot. Anti-Air Emplacements can also be destroyed by any of the offensive Stratagems (excluding Eagles ), Emplacement Stratagems , as well as the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or to save ammo. Damaging Grenades that have Heavy or above can destroy Anti-Air Emplacement. Thermite can 1-shot Anti-Air Emplacement if it sticks to it The G-12 High Explosive can also 1-shot Anti-Air Emplacement but requires them to detonate very close to the structure, typically by cooking the grenade and throwing it so it explodes in the air. The TED-63 Dynamite is more flexible due to higher explosion damage and larger blast radius so you only need to land the throwable in between two emplacements. Helldivers should be careful calling in an Eagle near the edge of the Anti-Air Emplacement. If Eagle 1 enters the AA's coverage she will be shot at and ALL eagles will be put on cooldown, as if the Eagle Rearm stratagem was used, while repairs to the craft are made. The crafts called in from the DSS Eagle Strike are unaffected and will perform Strafing Runs through the AA-Emplacements. If hit, the affected Eagle will immediately swerve up to safety to do more runs instead of having to leave.

雷达站保持在地图上隐藏，直到被绝地潜兵发现（标记）或通过到达其位置物理发现。由于它能揭示宝贵的信息，在任务早期定位该站应是优先事项。天线盘的正确朝向总是朝向地图外围最近的边界点。如果天线盘靠近地图西侧，它应指向西，以此类推。搜索雷达站可以通过扫描地平线寻找其独特结构或查看地图寻找典型的地形特征来简化。细心的绝地潜兵也可以记住任务“简报”中显示的所有热点区域的位置，以缩小未发现次要目标的位置范围，因为这些热点不会在任务小地图上高亮。地形将确认次要目标是否是雷达站还是其他东西。某些任务目标（如取回宝贵数据）具有类似的天线。在这种情况下，标记天线将揭示其用途。快速轻松完成雷达站目标的关键是沟通：建议在旋转天线前检查终端上的正确对齐方向。对齐期间，当天线正确对齐时会发出独特的蜂鸣声。这使绝地潜兵无需查看终端或依赖其他玩家的指示就能识别正确的对齐方向。绝地潜兵可以标记终端来呼叫正确的朝向，而无需依赖语音通信。使用语音通信通常使沟通更容易。绝地潜兵可以使用度数、指南针方向或时钟位置向队友指示正确的朝向。通常，简单的提示如“左边”或“另一个左边”更有效，因为队友可能不知道使用的是哪个参考系。建议在附近放置一个哨戒炮，在对齐过程中自动防御来袭威胁。
The Radar Station remains hidden on the map until it is either spotted (pinged) by a Helldiver or physically discovered by reaching its location. Due to the valuable information it reveals, locating the station early in the mission should be a priority. The Dish's correct orientation will always be towards the closest point that is on the outer perimeter of the map. If the dish is close to the west side of the map it should point west, and so forth. Searching for the Radar Station can be simplified by scanning the horizon for its distinctive structure or by checking the map for the typical surrounding topography. Attentive Helldivers can also memorize the location of all hotzones shown during mission "Briefing" to narrow down location of undiscovered secondary objectives due this hotzone not being highlighted on the mission minimap. Topographics will confirm whether or not the secondary objective is a Radar Station or something else. Some mission objectives (such as Retrieve Valuable Data ) feature a similar-looking antenna. In these cases, pinging the antenna will reveal its purpose. Communication is key for a quick and easy completion of the Radar Station objective: It is advised to check the correct alignment on the terminal before turning the antenna. During alignment, the antenna emits a distinctive beep when correctly aligned. This allows the Helldiver to identify the correct alignment without needing to see the terminal or rely on instructions from another player. Helldivers can ping the terminal to call out the correct orientation, without depending on voice comms. Using voice comms generally makes communication easier. Helldivers may use degrees, compass directions, or clock positions to indicate the correct orientation to teammates. Often, simple cues like "left" or "the other left" are more effective, as teammates may not know which reference is used. It is advised to place a sentry nearby to automatically defend against incoming threats during the alignment process.

Helldivers come out of the Hellpod fully stocked on Ammo, Grenades, and Stims.

装备后，小队中所有绝地潜兵钻出绝地喷射仓时（无论是初始部署还是被增援），弹药、手榴弹与兴奋剂均为满配。实际携带上限取决于所装备的护甲，数量会有所不同。
绝地潜兵总动员！
Helldivers Mobilize
勋章 ×15
⚙️ 具体效果
这是一个持续整场任务生效的效果：小队部署与增援时，主武器与副武器弹药、手榴弹、兴奋剂均以最大携带量出场。
医疗包、工程包等提升携带上限的护甲被动不会影响本强化资源，绝地潜兵始终获得其携带上限的 100%。
📌 备注

在「闪电战：搜索与摧毁」这类时间紧张的任务中尤其有用：需要快速往返机器人前哨站、虫巢与光能者跃迁舰。

绝密军团
Redacted Regiment
勋章 ×40
⚙️ 具体效果
所有绝地喷射仓（载人或无人）在撞击时释放一小团烟幕，遮挡落点周围区域，掩护绝地潜兵与装备。
💡 战术信息
玩家处于烟幕中时，敌人只有距离 10 米以内（最小视距）才能发现。
烟幕对所有绝地喷射仓生效，在敌人附近增援时尤其有用，可以争取在被发现前脱身。
烟幕还能掩护绝地潜兵执行某些任务类战略配备，例如启动 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹、拾取补给、向超级地球旗帜敬礼。
主要目标完成后立即呼叫的撤离信标也会被烟幕暂时遮蔽。附近敌人会被任何战略配备吸引，因此拾取支援武器时的隐蔽同样有用。

缩短绝地潜兵身上的火焰自动熄灭所需的时间，使其不再需要靠扑倒或卧倒来灭火。

勋章 ×65

缩短绝地潜兵身上火焰自动熄灭所需的时间，使其不再需要靠扑倒或卧倒来给自己灭火。
💡 战术信息
虽然扑倒可以立刻灭火，但不扑倒时绝地潜兵仍会持续着火一段时间；装备本强化资源后该时间会缩短（官方页面尚未给出具体秒数）。
在保持战场感知的前提下，本强化资源能减轻明火带来的伤害；视敌人、武器与环境不同，这份额外防护可以提升绝地潜兵的战场存活率。

贡献指南（HD2 中文维基 / 星图数据）
**先说最重要的一句：投稿不需要会写代码。**
只要你能指出「哪个条目的哪个地方不对」，就可以直接开一个
Issue，
用表单描述清楚，维护者会接手 —— **这条路完全不用碰数据文件**。
如果你想自己动手改数据，那确实要懂**一点点** JSON：数据类型的基础知识是必要的。
最典型的一条就是「**文字必须用半角双引号包住**」—— 写成中文引号 「绝地潜兵」 、 “绝地潜兵” 
会让整个文件直接坏掉，页面上的数据全都加载不出来。
好消息是规则只有 6 条、都很简单，见下面的 **§3「📝 极简 JSON 科普」**，
里面还附了 4 个可以直接复制粘贴的填空模板；CI 会自动帮你检查语法与字段。

本文面向**非技术的社区投稿者**。技术性的 schema 细节请看
 HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/SCHEMA.md （权威源）。

---
1. 数据在哪

所有数据都是**纯文本 JSON**（2026-09 起已统一为 2 空格缩进的多行可读格式），
可以直接在 GitHub 网页上阅读和编辑。
图鉴站数据 —— HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/ 
 文件 | 内容 | 大致条目数 |
---|---|---|
 weapons.json | **武器**（主武器 / 副武器 / 投掷物）及其数值、特性、tips | 103 |
 stratagems_full.json | **战略配备**（完整条目：呼叫代码、冷却、数值、详细面板） | 109 |
 loadout.json | **配装视图**的战略配备精简列表（四维评分，给「配装」页用） | 89 |
 enemies.json | **敌人**（阵营、血量、部位/弱点、攻击方式、出现难度） | 95 |
 missions.json | **任务**（主目标 / 各阵营目标 / 战术目标，含步骤与战术信息） | 5 类 / 105 项 |
 boosters.json | **强化资源**（Boosters：效果说明、所属债券、价格） | 20 |
 warbonds.json | **战争债券**（Warbonds：逐页奖励表、价格、发布时间） | 25 |
 factions.json | **阵营**（超级地球 + 三大敌对阵营的色彩与敌人清单） | 3 |
 terms.json | **术语表** —— 全站译名的**唯一真相源**（见 §4） | 1697 |
 mechanics/*.json | **机制页英文主干**（damage / difficulty / galactic_war / galactic_war_history / status_effects） | 5 页 |
 mechanics/*_zh.json | 机制页的**中文覆盖**（按小节覆盖中文标题与正文） | 5 页 |
 mechanics/index.json | 机制页的目录卡片 | 5 |
 index.json + blocks/*.json | 图鉴首页的区块与文案（欢迎语、导航分类、关于） | 4 |
 ds_terms.json | 特例术语数据（历史遗留，另有专门说明） | — |
星图站数据 —— HD2-Galatic_war-Map/ 
 文件 | 内容 | 备注 |
---|---|---|
 tables/*.json | 星图对照表（星球索引、星图连线、行星生态、战略配备镜像表、变量对照表…） | 机器同步，**一般不需要人工改** |
 data/campaign_zh.json | **「进行中的战役」中文化层**（战役名、阶段名、奖励类型、状态） | 人工维护 ✓ |
 banner.json | 星图首页顶部横幅文案 | 人工维护 ✓ |
### ⛔ 不要动 CI 自动生成的文件
下面这些文件**由 GitHub Actions 每 5 分钟 / 每天自动抓取并覆盖**，
你手动改的内容会在下一次自动运行后被冲掉：
- HD2-Galatic_war-Map/data.json 
- HD2-Galatic_war-Map/data/history/* （如 player_distribution.json ）
- HD2-Galatic_war-Map/data/translated/TransNews.json 
想改这些内容，请改**上游数据源**或对应的中文化层文件（如 campaign_zh.json ）。

---
2. 怎么改
方式 A：在 GitHub 网页上直接改（推荐，最快）
**🚀 5 步速查卡（TL;DR）**
1. 在 GitHub 上**打开要改的 JSON 文件** → 点右上角的**铅笔图标** ✏️（Edit this file）。
2. **改那几行**（文件已经是多行可读格式）→ 只改你要改的，别顺手重排格式。
3. 页面底部 **Commit changes**：写一句说明 → **必须选「Create a new branch for this commit
 and start a pull request」** → 点 **Propose changes**。
4. 新页面上把**标题**改成一句话，**描述**照模板写清「改了什么 / 为什么 / 依据」→ 点
 **Create pull request**。
5. 等 **Checks 变绿**（显示 **0 是正常的**，刷新等一下）；红了就点 **Details** 看
 **Job Summary**，改完提交到**同一个分支**；绿了等维护者点 **Merge pull request**。

下面是**细到「点哪个按钮」**的完整教程。第一次提 PR 照着走一遍就行。
A-1 · 打开要改的文件
网址规律： https://github.com/Jerry114514/Jerry114514.github.io/blob/main/ 
常用入口（直接点，或把网址里的路径换掉）：
术语表： HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/terms.json 
强化资源： HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/boosters.json 
武器： HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/weapons.json 
战役中文化： HD2-Galatic_war-Map/data/campaign_zh.json 
不想记路径就从仓库首页一层层点目录进
 （ HD2_Wiki → data → wiki → zh → 目标文件）。
打开后是**只读浏览**状态；右上角那排图标里的**铅笔** ✏️（鼠标悬停显示 **Edit this file**）
 就是入口，点它进入网页编辑器。
A-2 · 改内容
你会看到**多行可读**的 JSON（2026-09 起已统一为 2 空格缩进），一个字段一行，不再是一整行挤在一起。
 下面是 terms.json 里**真实存在**的一条：
 json
 {
 "en": "AC-8 Autocannon",
 "zh": "AC-8 机炮",
 "source": "stratagems_full.json",
 "note": "战略配备"
 }
 
**只改你要改的那几行**（一般就是改 zh 的值、补一条新条目、改一个数字）。
 顺手重排格式、整段复制覆盖，会让 diff 变得很大、审核和回滚都变麻烦。
三条最容易踩的坑（详见 **§3.1**）：文字必须用**半角**双引号 " ；**最后一项后面不能有逗号**；
 { } [ ] 必须成对。
⚠️ 别动**顶层 total **（除非你**新增**了条目：那就必须 +1，见 §3.6）。
A-3 · 提交对话框（最关键的一步，别选错）

拉到页面**最底部**的 **Commit changes** 区域：
**上面一行：commit message（提交说明）**
建议格式： : （冒号中英文都行，同一人保持一致即可）
真实示例： terms: 修正 AC-8 Autocannon 译名 、 boosters: 新增 Integrated Extinguishers 
**下面两个单选框（重点）**
✅ **Create a new branch for this commit and start a pull request** ← **选这个**
❌ ~~Commit directly to the main branch~~ ← **不要选这个**
**为什么**：直接提交到 main 会**绕过 PR 与 CI 校验** —— 数据一旦写坏会直接上线
 （那一页数据全都加载不出来），也没有任何人工审核的机会；后面的
 「Checks 红了怎么改」「维护者合并」整套流程全都用不上。
然后点 **Propose changes**。
A-4 · 分支名怎么起

选完上一项，GitHub 会展开一个**分支名输入框**，默认值是 你的用户名-patch-1 。
**直接用默认值是可以的** —— 维护者不会因为这个拒绝。
想更清楚就改成有意义的名字，建议格式： - - ，**全小写 + 连字符 - **：
 terms-ac8-translation 
 boosters-add-integrated-extinguishers 
 weapons-fix-ar2-id 
规则：不能有**空格**、不能有**中文**（GitHub 会直接拒绝）；同一仓库里不能和已有分支重名
 （重名报错就加个 -2 或换个名字）。
改好分支名后点 **Propose changes**，进入 PR 页面。
A-5 · 填写 PR 页面
**标题**：默认就是刚才那句 commit message，**建议改成一句话说清改了什么**，例如
 修正 AC-8 Autocannon 的中文译名（机炮 → 自动加农炮） 。
**描述**：把下面这段**整块复制**进去，删掉用不上的行、把 __…__ 换成实际内容：

 markdown
改了什么
 HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/terms.json ：AC-8 Autocannon 的 zh 由「AC-8 机炮」改为「AC-8 自动加农炮」
__涉及多个文件就一行一个__
为什么
游戏内简中实际显示为「AC-8 自动加农炮」，原译名与游戏内不一致。
依据
游戏内截图：__链接或说明__
出处 / 社区讨论帖：__链接__
自查
[ ] 只改了需要改的地方，没有重排格式、没有动其它条目
[ ] 文字都用半角双引号，没有中文引号「」“”
[ ] 新增条目时同步改了顶层 total
 
**base 分支**：页面顶部显示 base: main ← compare: ，**base 必须是 main **。
往下是**文件清单与 diff**，先扫一眼确认只改了该改的行，再点绿色的
 **Create pull request**。
 （想先存着、之后再请人看，可以点旁边的 **Create draft pull request**；草稿状态 CI 一样会跑，
 准备好后点 **Ready for review**。）
提交 PR 后请在描述里写清**依据**（出处链接 / 游戏内截图 / 社区讨论帖），
纯凭印象的改动维护者可能会先搁置。
A-6 · 等 CI：Checks 会从 0 → 运行中 → 绿/红
PR 页面**底部**有 **Checks** 区域（标题下方的小圆点也反映同一个状态）。
正常的状态变化：**Checks 显示 0** → 出现一条 Validate Data （校验 wiki / 星图数据）带黄色转圈
 → 变成 ✅ 绿 或 ❌ 红。
⚠️ **「Checks 显示 0」是正常的**：刚点完 Create pull request 时 GitHub 常常还没把检查挂上去，
 **等几秒到几十秒、刷新一下页面就会出现**。不要因为看到 0 就以为「校验不会跑了」，
 更不要为此关掉重开一个 PR。
顺带说明：以前工作流在 pull_request 上带 paths: 过滤，只改**页面**（例如
 HD2_Wiki/warbonds.html ）的 PR 根本不会创建这个检查；一旦分支保护把
 validate-data 设成「必需检查」，这类 PR 就会**永远等一个不会出现的检查**。
2026-09 已修正为 ** pull_request 无条件运行**。
同一个 PR 里连续提交多次时，**旧的那次运行会被自动取消**，只保留最新一次。
A-7 · 绿了之后
✅ 绿只代表「语法、必填字段、取值都合规」，**还要等维护者审核**。
维护者可能要一会儿（忙起来甚至几天）才处理 —— 这是业余维护的项目，**不用重新开 PR**。
 确实想提醒就在 PR 里礼貌回一句（例如补一张截图），别重复开 PR。
审核通过后，维护者会点 **Merge pull request** → **Confirm merge**；随后 GitHub 会提示
 **Delete branch**，删不删都不影响结果。

适用范围： HD2_Wiki/data/wiki/zh/ 及其子目录（ blocks/ 、 mechanics/ 、 fetch_reports/ ）下的全部 JSON 数据文件。
目的：把跨数据集已经事实存在的字段与约定写死，消除「同一语义多个字段名」「野生字段」的问题。
强制程度：**本文件是唯一权威**。任何新增字段都必须先在本文件第 7 节登记，否则视为野生字段。

AR/GL-21 “幺二”
AR/GL-21 One-Two
Problem we want to solve:
The combination of the Assault rifle and underbarrel grenade launcher made it a flexible weapon, but the amount of ammunition for the grenade launcher did not make it useful enough.
Intent and expectation with the changes:
Lean more into what makes the One-Two different from other Assault rifles.
It should be a flexible assault rifle that can use the underbarrel grenade launcher more often.
Changes:
Increased starting amount from 2 to 3.
Increased max spare amount from 3 to 5.
Increased refills from 3 to 5.
我们想解决的问题：
突击步枪与下挂榴弹发射器的组合让它成为一把灵活的武器，但榴弹发射器的弹药量不足以让它真正好用。
本次改动的意图与预期：
更突出“幺二”与其他突击步枪的不同之处。
它应当是一把灵活、能更频繁使用下挂榴弹发射器的突击步枪。
改动内容：
初始弹药量由 2 提高到 3。
最大备弹量由 3 提高到 5。
补给次数由 3 提高到 5。

G/40 热熔地雷 › 投掷物

G/40 热熔地雷
G/40 Melta Mine
Problem we want to solve:
Could attach to character and vehicle geometry in unintended ways.
This could lead to:
Sticking to Helldivers and obscure the players vision, or griefing.
Sometimes attach to enemies and direct the explosion towards the player.
Floating mines in the air.
Intent and expectation with the changes:
Should not stick to Helldivers and obscure the players vision.
Should not stick to enemies or vehicles in unexpected angles.
Prevent melta mines from floating in the air.
Changes:
The Melta Mine can no longer attach to characters and vehicles.
The Melta Mine can land and rest on sufficiently level surfaces of characters and vehicles.
The Mine will arm based on a timer from the throw unless it attaches to terrain.
我们想解决的问题：
它可能以非预期的方式附着到角色与载具的模型上。
这可能导致：
粘在绝地潜兵身上、遮挡视野，或者被用来恶意干扰队友。
有时附着到敌人身上，并把爆炸引向玩家。
地雷悬浮在空中。
本次改动的意图与预期：
不应粘在绝地潜兵身上遮挡视野。
不应以怪异角度粘在敌人或载具上。
防止热熔地雷悬浮在空中。
改动内容：
热熔地雷不再能附着到角色与载具上。
热熔地雷可以落在角色与载具足够平坦的表面上并停留在那里。
除非附着到地形，否则地雷将按投掷后的计时器进入待发状态。

LAS-13 三叉戟
LAS-13 Trident
Problem we want to solve:
Remove an unintended change that happened when we coded the functionality for the meltagun into the beam system which caused the Trident to become more impacted by vertical climb recoil.
Intent and expectation with the changes:
The intent was not for the Trident to have that much vertical climb recoil.
The main intent for it was to have some recoil to make the weapon feel more impactful to shoot and not to be that much part of the weapons power level.
Changes:
Decreased vertical climb recoil from 12 to 2.
我们想解决的问题：
我们在把热熔枪的功能写进光束系统时引入了一处非预期的改动，导致三叉戟更容易受到垂直上跳后坐力的影响。本次将其移除。
本次改动的意图与预期：
我们本意并不是让三叉戟有这么强的垂直上跳后坐力。
主要意图是保留一定后坐力，让射击手感更有分量，而不是让它成为武器强度的一部分。
改动内容：
垂直上跳后坐力由 12 降低到 2。

协助装填重做
Assisted Reload Rework
Problem we want to solve:
The original intent was a tactical action that needed collaboration with a designated reloader that carries the backpack
We have reevaluated how this works and with how the game has evolved since launch we reached the conclusion that the assisted reload action requires too much coordination which leads to it rarely happening
Intent and expectation with the change:
We want to reduce the complexity with assisted reloading to promote using it more.
Allow players to keep their backpack and reload whenever you need, while also allows a teammate to easily help you if the opportunity arises.
The change we made:
Helldivers can now assist reload as long as one of the wielder and/or reloader of the weapon has the correct backpack
我们想要解决的问题：
最初的意图是一种战术行动，需要与携带背包的指定装填手协作
我们重新评估了这一机制的运作方式，并结合游戏自发布以来的演变，得出结论：协助装填行动需要过多的协调配合，导致其很少发生
本次改动的意图与预期：
我们希望降低协助装填的复杂度，以促进其更多被使用。
允许玩家保留自己的背包，并在需要时随时装填，同时也允许队友在机会出现时轻松协助你。
我们所做的改动：
只要武器的持有者和/或装填者中有一方拥有正确的背包，绝地潜兵现在即可协助装填

平衡性
Balancing
Updated icons for backpack weapons and expendable weapons
Problem we want to solve:
Finding a specific weapon in the loadout can be hard to do with all the new weapons added to the arsenal
It can be hard to know if a support weapon needs a backpack or cannot be reloaded when only looking at the icon.
Intent and expectation with the change:
We want to make it easier to find specific weapons and to plan your loadout.
It should be easier to know when a weapon needs a backpack or cannot be reloaded when only looking at the icon.
The change we made:
Stratagem Weapons that require a backpack now have a backpack icon included on their loadout icons
Stratagem Weapons that cannot be reloaded now have a drop weapon icon included on their loadout icons.
Decreased heavy landing duration
The original intent was to make the heavy landing feel like you recovered from a high fall.
The player lost control for a long time when landing on their feet from a higher fall.
We wanted to make it smoother to recover from the heavy landing state and not remove the control for too long.
While still making it feel like a heavy landing recovery
Decreased the duration for the heavy landing animation by around 40%
Stim action input smoothing
Players can experience dead input when trying to stim when the stim action was not allowed.
We want to lessen the feeling of dead input when using the stim action.
We changed so the stim input is remembered for a short duration when the action is not allowed and will be executed if the stim action is allowed within that duration.
This works similarly to how the reload input action changes from the last patch.
Ammo re-balance for Short magazines attachments and Secondaries
The benefits of the short magazines are too few compared to drum magazines.
The benefits of some of the anti-personnel sidearms do not have enough benefits compared to other sidearm options.
Give more benefits to short magazines to make the items more useful compared to drum magazines for the same weapon.
Give more benefits to some of the lesser used anti-personnel sidearms to make the items more useful
Short magazines got more max spare and starting magazines.
Some of the anti-personnel sidearms got more max spare and starting magazines.

Problem we want to solve:
The missions have fallen behind in difficulty, making it so they feel boring and easy for many players that have access to good tools for these types of missions.
Intent and expectation with the changes:
The missions should feel more intense and be more difficult to complete, especially in lobbies with 3-4 players.

Increased the maximum amount of waves.
Reduced the time between waves to reduce downtime between each wave.

Reduced the end time between waves from 40 seconds to 28 seconds, the time between waves at the end of the mission.
Reduced the maximum time between waves from 10 seconds to 2 seconds, the time between waves when finished the previous wave.
Increased amount of enemies that can spawn in each wave.
Increased encounter points through the steps of the mission more exponentially.
Increased encounter points when more players are present.
Enabled possibility to spawn SEAF troops, when included.
Bug changes:
Chance to spawn Shriekers.
Level Design changes:
Randomized loot location and weapons.
Added 3 random groups for loot like ammo, health kits, grenades, weapons.
Added 10 common samples to collect throughout the mission.
Mission Objective Changes:
Added UI for each generator showing the health percentage.

敌人生成
Enemy Spawning
Problem we want to solve:
Sometimes enemies did not spawn in a balanced way between players if the team spread out over the map. We also sometimes used the enemy budget on enemies that were far away from players and were not really relevant to them.
Intent and expectation with the changes:
Enemy spawns are more balanced between separated Helldivers on missions, giving all players a more consistent game experience.
Changes:
Enemy pressure on Helldivers is now measured based on enemies count and distance and used to balance enemy spawns.
In a situation where a Helldiver is on low enemy pressure and the global enemies count reaches the maximum, set for performance reasons, enemies are preferably spawned near them.
This should address the feeling of roaming into empty outposts in such situations.
When enemies count is over budget, far away enemies are despawned.
我们想解决的问题：
当队伍分散在地图各处时，敌人的生成有时无法在玩家之间取得平衡。我们有时还会把敌人预算花在离玩家很远、与玩家无关的敌人身上。
本次改动的意图与预期：
敌人生成在分散执行任务的绝地潜兵之间更均衡，让所有玩家的游戏体验更一致。
改动内容：
对绝地潜兵构成的「敌人压力」现在会依据敌人数量与距离计算，并用于平衡敌人生成。
当某名绝地潜兵处于低敌人压力、而全局敌人数量已达到（出于性能考虑设定的）上限时，敌人会优先在他附近生成。
这应当能缓解上述情况下「跑进空荡前哨」的感觉。
当敌人数量超出预算时，距离很远的敌人会被清除。

概述
Overview
Attention Helldivers,
This hotfix addresses a number of issues reported after the release of Machinery of Oppression (6.2.5).
We’re continuing to track feedback around upscaling quality and performance, and Nixxes and Arrowhead are actively working on further optimizations and improvements.
绝地潜兵们，请注意，
本次热修复解决了铁腕威压（6.2.5）发布后报告的若干问题。
我们将持续跟踪有关超分辨率画质与性能的反馈，Nixxes 与 Arrowhead 正在积极进行进一步的优化与改进。

概述
Overview
Attention Helldivers,
High Command has authorized a significant tactical update with both content and quality of life upgrades. We are deploying Helldivers in new Galactic Campaigns, making upgrades to the new diver training program, and making essential fixes and upgrades across the board.
We have also made changes to weapon, stratagem, and enemy balancing based on feedback from Helldivers on the frontlines, including reductions to enemy durable damage and a decreased exosuit cooldown.
Helldivers, we are committed to making the necessary upgrades to keep you in the fight. Because you have never given up on Managed Democracy, we will never give up on making it easier for you to spread.
绝地潜兵们，请注意，
超级地球最高司令部已批准一项重大战术更新，包含内容与体验优化。我们将在新的银河战役中部署绝地潜兵，改进新兵训练计划，并进行全面的必要修复与升级。
我们还根据前线绝地潜兵的反馈，对武器、战略配备和敌人平衡进行了调整，包括降低敌人的耐久伤害和缩短机甲冷却时间。
绝地潜兵们，我们致力于进行必要的升级，让你们继续战斗。因为你们从未放弃管理式民主，我们也永远不会放弃让传播民主变得更轻松。

概述
Overview
Attention Helldivers,
The race to assemble the TCS+ is heating up and High Command is rolling out some stability improvements to ensure every Helldiver makes it to the battlefield in style.
绝地潜兵们请注意，
组装 TCS+ 的竞赛正在升温，超级地球最高司令部正在推出一些稳定性改进，以确保每一位绝地潜兵都能帅气地抵达战场。

概述
Overview
Helldivers, you are needed on the battlefield of a new frontier – one more wild and uncertain than any we have faced prior. We are so close to entering the Void.
Stay frosty, divers. As you fight your way toward the Void, you’ll encounter new, hideously mutated organisms. We have received intelligence reports that indicate these metamorphosed creatures are emerging from the heart of the Void – they are ghoulish diversions wrought into existence by the Illuminate scourge to threaten our freedom.

通用平衡改动 › 平衡

通用平衡改动
General balance changes
Vehicle armor and enemies AP rebalance
Super Earth vehicles now have more accurate Armor values (Bastion gets heavy armor, exosuits a mix of heavy and medium armor, ballistic shield heavy armor).
Some enemies have received increased armor penetration values so they can deal with the vehicles, but not all. There will be a lot of smaller enemies and explosions that won't be able to hurt something like the Bastion or the Exo Suits (scavengers, Automatons small arms fire, hunters, small to medium obstacle explosions, cyborg small arms etc).
But there are still a lot in the enemies arsenal that can hurt you (and also important is that a lot of YOUR arsenal now has a harder time hurting your own vehicles).
Some enemies have had their durable damage reduced
There are too many changes to properly list, so we ask you to play and tell us how it feels. The intent is the following
The Bastion tank should feel "tankier" and ignore small attacks, withstand more medium attacks and its survivability against heavy attacks should be unchanged
The Exo Suits have a similar change as the Bastion tank in terms of ignoring more small attacks and withstanding medium attacks better. The increase in health should overall make it feel a bit more tanky even against heavy attacks.
The FRV has received an increase in health that will make it handle medium attacks similar to before, but be able to withstand heavy attacks better granting better survivability.
The Ballistic Shield should feel like it can ignore small attacks and handle medium attacks better.
Sentry health rebalance
Increased the health of all sentries by 100% to compensate for the general damage increase of enemies vs vehicles.
We have previously increased durable damage on a lot of enemies and since sentries are durable they have lost some of their utility. We didn't want them to become squishier, this change should improve their versatility on the battlefield.
Reloading improvements
Improvements to make reloading more responsive, part of this is allowing reloading while dodge diving, also remembering the reload state better so if you're ragdolled while reloading you will continue it when regaining control.
Introduced the concept of delayed reloads. If you try to trigger a reload while the player is not allowed to do so, the reload will be delayed until the player is able to reload with a maximum of 1.2s delay from when the reload input was pressed.
Bastion Pattern Customization
If you own the vehicle patterns from a Premium Warbond, they can now also be applied to the Bastion Tank! It does not apply to Legendary Warbonds retroactively at this time.
Decreased Exo Suit cooldown
Reduce the cooldown of mechs from 10 minutes down to 8. The intent is to find a better balance with mechs and allow more time with fun stratagems
Throwables amounts rebalance
Intent is to make some of the less used throwables more available and viable options
Orbitals damage rebalance
Intent is to make the larger orbitals feel more like the large projectiles from orbit as they are so the projectile and explosion damage should better match that.
Larger projectiles explosions like the 380mm and 120mm are increased to make close hits more effective vs larger enemies like Chargers.
Compared to explosions like the Ultimatum these will have less damage at the center, but also less damage fall off so it will have a more consistent damage over its total area.
The Railcannon also got more damage to be more effective vs some of the largest enemies like the Vox engines. It will still not one shot the largest enemies like Factory strider, Hive lord and similar.
载具装甲与敌人 AP 重新平衡
超级地球载具现在拥有更准确的装甲值（Bastion 获得重甲，机甲混合重甲与中甲，弹道护盾为重甲）。
部分敌人获得了更高的装甲穿透值，以便能够应对载具，但并非所有敌人都如此。仍有许多小型敌人和爆炸无法伤害 Bastion 或机甲之类目标（scavengers、机器人轻武器火力、hunters、小型至中型障碍物爆炸、生化人轻武器等）。
但敌人武器库中仍有许多能伤害你（同样重要的是，你的武器库中许多现在也更难伤害你自己的载具）。
部分敌人的耐久伤害已降低
改动太多无法一一列出，因此我们请求你们游玩并告诉我们感受。意图如下
Bastion 坦克应感觉更“肉”，无视小型攻击，承受更多中型攻击，且其面对重型攻击的生存能力应保持不变
机甲在无视更多小型攻击和更好地承受中型攻击方面与 Bastion 坦克有类似改动。生命值提升应整体使其感觉更肉，即使面对重型攻击也是如此。
FRV 的生命值已提升，使其应对中型攻击与之前类似，但能更好地承受重型攻击，从而提供更好的生存能力。
弹道护盾应感觉能无视小型攻击并更好地应对中型攻击。
哨戒炮生命值重平衡
将所有哨戒炮的生命值提高 100%，以补偿敌人对载具伤害的整体提升。
我们此前提高了很多敌人的耐久伤害，而哨戒炮属于耐久单位，因此失去了一部分实用性。我们不希望它们变得更脆，这一改动应能提升它们在战场上的泛用性。
装填改进
改进装填的响应性，其中一部分是允许在闪避扑倒时进行装填，同时更好地记录装填状态，这样如果你在装填时被击飞，恢复控制后会继续装填。
引入延迟装填的概念。如果你在玩家不允许装填时尝试触发装填，装填将被延迟，直到玩家能够装填为止，最多延迟 1.2 秒（从按下装填输入时算起）。
Bastion 涂装自定义
如果你拥有来自高级战争债券的载具涂装，现在它们也可以应用到 Bastion 坦克上！目前不会追溯适用于传奇战争债券。
降低 Exo Suit 冷却时间
将机甲的冷却时间由 10 分钟降低至 8 分钟。目的是在机甲上找到更好的平衡，并让玩家有更多时间使用有趣的战略配备。
投掷物数量重平衡
目的是让一些较少使用的投掷物成为更易获得且更可行的选择。
轨道武器伤害重平衡
目的是让较大的轨道武器更符合其作为来自轨道的大型弹体的定位，因此其弹体和爆炸伤害应更好地与之匹配。
380mm 和 120mm 等较大弹体的爆炸得到增强，使近失弹对 Chargers 等较大敌人更有效。
与 Ultimatum 等爆炸相比，这些爆炸在中心处的伤害更低，但伤害衰减也更小，因此在其整个作用范围内伤害会更加稳定。
Railcannon 也获得了更高伤害，以更有效地对抗 Vox engines 等一些最大的敌人。它仍然无法一枪击杀 Factory strider、霸王虫等最大的敌人。

伤害机制 › 传导至主体的伤害（% to Main）

传导至主体的伤害（% to Main）
Percent (%) to Main
部位受到的伤害通常会按一定比例同时传导给主体（Main）的生命值池，比例因部位而异。大多数部位会把传导给主体的伤害封顶在该部位的最大生命值，少数部位允许溢出伤害全部进入主体。
封顶实例：蹂躏者主体生命值 750，手臂生命值 260、向主体传导 50%；AR-23 解放者单发对臂部造成 90 点伤害，臂部剩余 170，同时有 45 点伤害传导至主体，主体剩余 705。
不封顶实例：劫掠者主体生命值 125，手臂生命值 65、向主体传导 50%；R-6 鹰眼单发会把全部 300 点伤害打在手臂上，其中 150 点传导至主体，足以直接杀死劫掠者。
因此即使主体生命值不为零，致命部位被摧毁也可能直接杀死敌人。
Enemy parts that take damage generally have a percentage of the damage dealt to them also be applied to their Main Health. Most enemy parts will cap the damage to main at their full HP value, however some parts allow excess damage to overflow into Main.
 
 Regular Example: A Devastator's Main Health is 750, with its arms having 260 Health and 50% damage to main. An AR-23 Liberator deals 90 damage to the arms leaving them at 170 Health. 45 damage is also dealt to the Main Health leaving it at 705. 
 Uncapped Damage Example: A Trooper's Main Health is 125, with its arms having 65 Health and 50% damage to main. A single shot from an R-6 Deadeye will deal its full 300 damage to the arms, dealing 150 damage to the Trooper's Main Health which will kill it.

伤害机制 › 伤害衰减

伤害衰减
Damage Fall-Off
许多伤害来源会独立于目标产生衰减。伤害衰减受口径（Caliber）、初速度（Speed）、质量（Mass）与阻力（Drag）影响，分为两类：基于速度的衰减（弹道）与基于距离的衰减（爆炸）。弹丸速度低于枪口初速时会损失伤害，高于枪口初速时会获得伤害增益——可以通过俯冲、用 LIFT-850 喷射背包跳跃，或乘坐 M-102 快速侦察载具高速移动来获得增益。弹丸会因阻力系数损失速度；在向下坡方向射击时（例如使用阻力 0% 但受重力影响的 JAR-5 主宰）也可能出现伤害增加，除此之外，无论高低差如何，速度损失与重力影响对大多数武器都是常态。制导类弹丸是例外：它们在损失速度后会被程序补回初始速度，因此不会损失伤害，这类武器包括 FAF-14 飞矛、MLS-4X 突击兵、P-33 制导手枪、P-92 法令与 StA-X3 WASP发射器。阻力为 0% 的武器不受伤害衰减影响。弹丸附带的爆炸不受该体系影响，只有弹丸本身受影响。需要注意：武器的伤害数值是贴脸距离下的伤害，随飞行距离增加而下降。
Many damage sources can suffer from reduction independently of their target. Damage fall-off is affected by Caliber, Speed, Mass, and Drag. There are two types; velocity-based fall-off (ballistics) and range-based fall-off (explosions).
 
 If a projectile is slower than its muzzle velocity, damage is lost. 
 If a projectile is faster than its muzzle velocity, damage is gained.
 This can be achieved via diving, jumping with the LIFT-850 Jump Pack or traveling at high speeds in the M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle . 
 Projectiles lose velocity due to drag factor. Damage increase can occur when firing at a target at a lower elevation using, for instance, JAR-5 Dominator which has 0% Drag but is affected by gravity. Reduction in speed and gravity is otherwise typical for most weapons no matter the elevation.
 An exception to this rule are weapons with guided projectiles. Guided projectiles lose speed but are programmed to accelerate to match their initial velocity, simultaneously resulting in no damage lost. These weapons are the FAF-14 Spear , MLS-4X Commando , P-33 Missile Pistol , P-92 Warrant , and StA-X3 W.A.S.P. Launcher . 
 Weapons with 0% drag do not suffer damage fall-off. 
 The explosion from projectiles is not affected by this system, only the projectile. 
 One important thing to note, these damage values are the damage done at point-blank range. Damage decreases as the distance traveled increases.
伤害机制 › 伤害计算

伤害计算
Damage Calculation
在《绝地潜兵 2》中计算伤害需要考虑大量变量。本节全部伤害计算信息已核对至游戏版本 1.001.001。
[ 1 ] Calculating Damage in Helldivers 2 takes a large number of variables into consideration.
All damage calculation information in this section of the document has been confirmed to be accurate as of Game Version 1.001.001
伤害机制 › 体质值 / 流血（Constitution & Bleedout）

体质值 / 流血（Constitution & Bleedout）
Health Constitution (Bleed)
体质值（Constitution）是敌人的第二条生命池。当主体（Main）生命值耗尽后，敌人进入「倒地（downed）」状态，会一瘸一拐地行动，体质值按固定速率持续流失（即「流血 / bleedout」），流尽即死亡——流血通常是致命的。四肢被摧毁后同样会开始流血；部分肢体的流失速率（decay）为 0，表示它不会自行流失，必须继续输出伤害把流血值打空才能彻底摧毁该肢体。
体质值与耐久度（Durability）是两件事：耐久度决定部位承伤时「标准伤害 : 耐久伤害」的换算比例，体质值则是独立的生命池与死亡计时器。
实例一（强袭虫）：体质值 750、流失速率 100 hp/s，打爆其臀部或耗尽主体生命值都会触发倒地，随后它持续流血直至死亡。
实例二（移动工厂）：腿部生命值 1,500、体质值 2,000，且流失速率为 0，因此体质值等效于额外生命值，单腿等效血量 = 1,500 + 2,000 = 3,500。
Constitution is a second health pool that begins decaying once the main health is depleted. The enemy is now in the "downed" state and will limp until they bleedout and die. Bleedout is a second health pool for limbs that determines how long they live for once they are destroyed, at which point, its Constitution will begin to decay, or "bleed out," at a set rate. For some limbs, the decay rate may be 0, meaning they will not decay over time and bleedout must be depleted with further damage to fully destroy the limb.
 
 Constitution Example: Chargers have 750 constitution with a decay rate of 100hp/s. Destroying the butt or depleting main health will trigger the "downed" state and the Charger will bleed out until it depletes its constitution and dies. Bleedout is usually fatal. 
 Bleedout without Decay Example: Factory Striders have 1,500 leg health and 2,000 constitution but 0 decay therefore the constitution effectively behaves as extra health so the legs have 3,500 effective health.
伤害机制 › 元素倍率

元素倍率
Elemental Multipliers
元素伤害与状态效果通过倍率结算，最常见的是火焰，少数敌人还带有电弧或毒气状态伤害倍率（例如肉瘤体受到 1.8x 电弧伤害倍率、绝地潜兵受到 1.3x 毒气伤害倍率）。倍率与敌人体型相关：体型越大倍率越高，体型越小倍率越低。火焰倍率实例：武斗虫 0.8x、虫群指挥官 1x、强袭虫 1.5x、吐酸泰坦 1.7x。机械类与大型敌人的状态阈值更高，比有机体更难被点燃。
Elemental damage and Status Effects operate via damage multipliers, the most common being Fire, though there are few enemies with Arc and Gas status effect damage multipliers that are also affected. Such as Fleshmobs receiving a 1.8x Arc damage multiplier or Helldivers with a 1.3x Gas damage multiplier. These multipliers operate are based on enemy size; the larger the enemy the higher the multiplier and vice versa, with smaller enemies having a smaller multiplier.
 
 Fire damage multiplier examples: Warriors have a 0.8x multiplier, Brood Commanders have a 1x multiplier, Chargers have a 1.5x multiplier, and Bile Titans have a 1.7x multiplier,. 
 Robotic and large enemies have higher status thresholds and take longer to ignite than organic.

伤害机制 › 可破坏装甲板

可破坏装甲板
Breakable Armor Plating
某些敌人拥有可破坏装甲板，覆盖在脆弱或致命部位之上。拥有可破坏装甲板的敌人有：监察者、新月监察者、悬浮监察者、猎杀器、利维坦、吐酸泰坦、强袭虫、巨兽强袭虫、爆裂强袭虫、孢子强袭虫、穿刺虫、霸王虫与移动工厂。装甲板拥有与下方部位相互独立的生命值池，超出装甲板的伤害不会传递给下方部位；必须先把装甲板彻底打碎，才能伤害下方那个通常致命的脆弱部位。官方例子：用 MLS-4X 突击兵的火箭打碎强袭虫的腿部装甲，再用 BR-14 审判者等主武器解决暴露出来的脆弱血肉。
Some enemies have protective armor plating shielding vulnerable and fatal parts underneath it. The enemies that have this are Crescent Overseers , Elevated Overseers , Overseers , Harvesters , Leviathans , Bile Titans , Chargers , Charger Behemoths , Rupture Chargers , Spore Chargers , Impalers , Hive Lords, and Factory Striders .
 
 Breakable armor plating has a separate health pool from the parts underneath it that DOES NOT transfer excess damage to the parts underneath. The armor plating must be destroyed in order to deal damage to the vulnerable and usually fatal part underneath.
 For example: Destroying a Charger's Leg Armor with a rocket from the MLS-4X Commando and finishing off the exposed vulnerable flesh off with a primary weapon such as the BR-14 Adjudicator .

弹道学
Ballistics
弹道学描述弹丸的飞行特性及其对伤害衰减的影响：口径（Caliber）会急剧增加伤害衰减；初速度（Speed）越高，伤害衰减略微增加；质量（Mass）越大，衰减越小；阻力（Drag）越大，衰减越大；重力系数（Gravity Multiplier）决定弹丸在飞行中下坠的幅度。
Caliber: Drastically increases damage fall-off. 
 Speed: The bullet's initial magnitude to its velocity, higher speed increases damage fall-off slightly. 
 Mass: Reduces damage falloff. 
 Drag: Increases damage falloff. 
 Gravity Multiplier: How much the bullet drops in travel.

伤害机制 › 护甲穿透与护甲值

护甲穿透与护甲值
Armor Penetration & Armor Values
每个敌人的每个部位都有自己固定的护甲值（Armor Value，AV），数值范围为 0–10；这个数字表示该部位的装甲程度，也决定武器需要多少护甲穿透（Armor Penetration，AP）才能对它造成伤害。AP 记作 AP0–10，AV 记作 AV0–10。
武器侧同样有一套穿透值，伤害按三档结算：AP 大于 AV 造成 100% 伤害（红色准星）；AP 等于 AV 造成 65% 伤害（白色准星）；AP 小于 AV 不造成伤害（跳弹）。
官方共 13 个命名档位：AV-1 无受击框、AV0 无护甲、AV1 极轻甲、AV2 轻甲、AV3 中甲、AV4 重甲、AV5 坦克 I、AV6 坦克 II、AV7 坦克 III、AV8 坦克 IV、AV9 坦克 V、AV10 坦克 VI、AV11 坚不可摧；穿透侧一一对应为 AP-1 无受击框、AP0 无护甲、AP1 极轻甲……直到 AP5 反坦克 I 至 AP10 反坦克 VI、AP11 坚不可摧（官方原注：本表并非穷尽清单，仅作举例）。
角度穿透方面，每把武器各有 4 个穿透值，按入射角分档：小于 25°（近似直射）、26°–60°、61°–80°、81°–90°。前三档的数值通常相同，因此可以概括为「一个通用穿透值 + 一个跳弹角」；入射角进入最后一档后不再按通用穿透值结算。爆炸只使用一个穿透值，进入外圈后降低 1。
Every part of every Enemy has a specific Armor Value, with a range of 0 to 10. This number indicates how armored that part is, and how much armor penetration or AP a Weapon needs to be to deal damage to it.
 
 Armor Penetration is abbreviated as AP0-10. 
 Armor Values are abbreviated as AV0-10.
